maria_p: Heads-up: pilot customer wants per-response traceability + token accounting in the API response so they can join logs and billing without console pulls. Can we define a concrete minimal schema?

sanjay_api: Yes. Keep it small and stable. Proposal minimal fields: meta.trace_id, meta.request_id, usage.input_tokens/output_tokens/total_tokens. No hostnames or internal ids.

kai_ml: Add tokenizer_id (model-side tokenizer/version) so token counts are reproducible. Token counts must be model-consumed ints. Note: tokenization differs by model so call it out in docs.

ellie_cs: From support: customers expect consistency Hosted vs Dedicated. If we vary fields, flag differences prominently. Enterprise customers might want inline billing_cost_usd. Make that opt-in.

maria_p: Rollout idea: GA = minimal surface on Hosted (enabled). Extended fields (route_hint, deployment_info, billing_cost_usd, tokenizer_id) = enterprise feature-flag for Dedicated/Private.

sanjay_api: Shape suggestion (top-level to avoid breaking parsers):

```json
{ "meta": { "trace_id": "r-abc123", "request_id": "req-20260321-1" }, "usage": { "input_tokens": 12, "output_tokens": 88, "total_tokens": 100 }, "response": { "choices": [...] } }
```

kai_ml: For embeddings/rerank include usage.unit ("tokens" vs "embedding_units"). Optionally include usage.unit_cost when billing inline.

ellie_cs: Launch checklist: SDK mapping (py/js), docs + examples (curl/python/js), privacy review for route_hint/deployment_info, opt-out for billing_cost_usd.

maria_p: Spec limits: trace_id prefix r- and max 128 chars. trace_id stable across automatic retries/fallbacks for the same logical request. If user issues a fresh retry, new trace_id.

sanjay_api: Implementation note: router stamps trace_id on ingress. On fallback keep same trace_id and append to meta.fallback_to array with {model, route} details (enterprise-only).

kai_ml: Will add tokenizer_id field and a short paragraph about tokenization caveats (system messages, prompt truncation). Also add test cases for token-count reproducibility.

ellie_cs: I'll prepare customer comms and support playbook with examples showing correlation to console exports. Devex will include snippets.

ops-bot: deploy queued for branch feature/response-meta (sha: d4e5f6) :rocket:

maria_p: Action items: @sanjay_api open schema PR + feature flag; @kai_ml add tokenizer_id + tests; @ellie_cs draft comms. Review in Thursday sync.

(End of thread)
